trigger: An integrity comparison found simulator-successful episodes that the derived relation diagnostic marked neutral. The compiler and semantic execution scorer were using axis-aligned bounding-box centroids, while RoboLab's left/right predicate calls world.get_pose and therefore uses rigid-object root poses transformed into the robot frame.

correction.closed_loop_geometry: Use saved rubiks_cube and bowl rigid-object root poses, transform their displacement into the saved robot-root frame, and apply the 45-degree horizontal directional cone.
correction.task_relation_only_diagnostic: Mirror the matched terminal direction predicate without adding a height gate. Binary success continues to supply the registered gripper-detachment requirement.
correction.semantic_execution_geometry: Use the same root-pose robot-frame displacement, while retaining the semantic scorer's independently frozen absolute delta-z <= 0.1 m reliability rule.
correction.visual_calibration: Continue using rendered-object bounding-box centroids for camera/localizer calibration because they represent visible object centers. No localizer output, bias, plane, frame index, threshold, or prompt changes.

outcome_timing_disclosure: All 20 Cosmos declarative outcomes were known (19 successes). The first nine contrastive-left outcomes had completed (one success); no contrastive-right outcome existed. Canonical and short Cosmos outcomes were already known. No original-confirmation or stress semantic localization/label had been produced.
primary_outcome_impact: None. RoboLab binary success records, task stopping, prompts, actions, futures, seeds, and episode inclusion are unchanged.
secondary_outcome_impact: Final signed offsets, relation-only/strict progression diagnostics, executed semantic relations, and imagined-versus-executed quadrant assignments may change. They will be compiled once from the corrected source and reported as post-freeze derived diagnostics.
validation_rule: For every binary-success episode, the saved final root poses must satisfy the requested horizontal cone. Bounding-box centroids remain available only for visual/renderer variation audits.
claim_boundary: This correction aligns evaluation with the simulator source. It does not improve policy behavior or interpret the natural-language prompt.
